title: Party invite handshake (invite, accept, decline, expire)
oneLine: A pending party invite: one timestamp per inviter>target pair, checked at accept, swept after 60 s.
topConcern: Docs say per-sender-session; the key is the stable player id pair, so an invite survives the inviter's reconnect (harmless).

title: Party membership and the stored roster
oneLine: Who is in which party, across _parties, _partyByPlayer, _partyUnknownIds and party:/party_by_player: storage, under three live switches.
topConcern: Turning partykeep off leaves stored parties' offline members without awaySince, so the old grace sweep never removes them; they show 'away' forever.

title: Party leader succession (leave, restart, idle hand-on)
oneLine: Who leads a party: oldest member on a leave, first online member after the leader is unseen for 7 days.
topConcern: The idle hand-on needs seen > 0; converted clans give offline members seen 0, so a never-returning former clan leader leads forever.

title: Party member presence: online, away, offline, last seen
oneLine: A member's awaySince and seen stamps, derived away/off/dead flags, and the 2 s roster re-echo while anyone is on.
topConcern: The disconnect's seen is memory-only and joins write it at most every 6 h, so after a deploy last-seen can be hours early.

title: Alliance status hysteresis, board row and lazy index
oneLine: Whether a party is an alliance (20 active to become, 15 to stay), its board row, and the lazy index.
topConcern: A party in memory that nobody is on is never re-counted; the board trusts its stale on while row-only parties apply DROP.

title: Alliance name and tag with a 24 h rename wait
oneLine: An alliance's name, tag and renamedAt: first naming free, then once a day, unique across alliances and clans.

title: Alliance war: declare, score, resolve and pay, cooldown
oneLine: A 30-minute war between two alliances, scored by No man's land kills, paid by opId, then an hour's rest.
topConcern: Docs say a war 'stands still' under alliance:false, but endTime is absolute: the clock runs and it resolves the moment the switch is back.

title: Alliance tag as worn (state, session data, peers)
oneLine: The allyTag a player wears, mirrored on ps, session data and every phone, re-asserted at roster changes, joins and echoes.

title: Clans become parties (one-way conversion pass)
oneLine: Each stored clan turned into a stored party, or dissolved, at the first join after a deploy.
topConcern: Offline members get seen 0, so the party's idle-leader hand-on never fires for a converted clan's absent leader (S8-3).

title: Clan registry, invites and wars (pre-alliance clans)
oneLine: The old clan membership, pending clan invites and lawless-zone clan wars, live only under clanparty:false.
topConcern: Retired: clan creation debits 500 gold then awaits two separate puts; a restart between keeps the debit with no clan.

title: Friend requests and friendships (stored handshake)
oneLine: Stored friends:<pid> docs with list, incoming and outgoing requests; request, accept, decline, remove.
topConcern: No withdraw and no expiry for an outgoing request: requests to players who never answer fill the 25 slots for good (too-many-requests).

title: Offline DM backlog
oneLine: A capped mailbox of DMs to an offline friend, delivered once at their next join and deleted.
topConcern: Delivered-once: a backlog sent into a closing socket is lost (deliberate).

title: Chat guard per connection: social allowance and repeat memory
oneLine: session.chatGuard: token allowance for room chat, emotes and party chat, and a 30 s repeat memory for room/area lines.
topConcern: Room chat spends its token before cleaning and the repeat check; party chat only once the line is real (minor drift).

title: Chat lane bucket (area chat, whispers, friend DMs)
oneLine: A per-player token bucket shared by area chat, whispers and friend DMs, in memory.
topConcern: _laneBuckets is never pruned (one entry per player id for the worker's life) and drops the fractional refill unlike the other buckets.

title: Server mute list (stored, cached, paced writes)
oneLine: A muter's chat_mute doc: cached at join for the fan-out, edits written at a pace, flushed at close.
topConcern: A change past the burst waits in a timer up to 10 s; a deploy inside that window loses it.

title: Abuse reports (context ring, rate gate, stored report)
oneLine: A chat report: the server's copy of recent lines, a per-reporter rate gate, stored until dismissed or 30 days old.
topConcern: _chatReportLog trims only on the same reporter's next report (tiny, deliberate in-memory budget).

title: Held pose (sit, sleep, dance) and the emote relay
oneLine: ps.po on the server and S._pose on the phone: a held pose until a real move or a stand-up message.
topConcern: No server path clears ps.po at a death or respawn; a hidden-tab sleeper killed keeps po and peers keep snoring at the corpse.

title: Look relay baseline (whole, deltas, whole every minute)
oneLine: session._look: what every phone was last told of a player's look, so a track relays only what changed.

title: Feedback board: rate windows, vote toggle, crash ring
oneLine: Per-claimed-id hourly windows, a ticket's per-voter up/down toggle, and a 200-report crash ring in the Feedback DO.
topConcern: Public route takes playerId from the body: anyone votes as any id (unlimited) and the hourly limit is per claimed id.

title: Leaderboard rows and the room's report throttle
oneLine: session._lbSig/_lbAt decide when the room re-posts a player's row; rows older than 7 days drop off the answer.
topConcern: player: rows are never deleted and every public GET /top lists all of them.

title: Bot fingerprint record: hydrate, score, caps, flag, put, evict
oneLine: Per-identity anti-bot record in a 128-slot map: hydrated at join, decaying score, hour caps, flags, paced botstat: writes.
topConcern: An evicted online player's record is recreated fresh by the next hit and its next put overwrites stored flags, counters, hour count and sig.

title: Server bot signals and the optional Turnstile re-check
oneLine: rec.sig: walk, gesture, cook, reflex, rooted, streak and route measures, a score, a flag, and a re-check owed.
topConcern: reverify is re-armed at every evaluation while the score stands, so a flagged player is asked at every join, not once a flag (switch off).

title: Guild quest ladder (stored rung per skill)
oneLine: guild_claims:<pid> counts the rungs paid per life skill; the phone's _guildProgress copies it only from a result.
topConcern: The server's rung is never sent at join; after a character restart (claims kept) the panel offers a rung already paid.
